name: גֶּבֶר
summary: Geber son of Uri, one of Solomon's twelve officers, over the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon and Og (1Ki 4:19); and in “Ben-Geber”, the officer in Ramoth-gilead, whom the list names by his father (1Ki 4:13). The name is the noun גֶּבֶר, “man”.

evidence.note: “גֶּבֶר son of Uri, in the land of Gilead.”
